question: After removing any duplicate records from the rev_transactions dataset, identify each channel grouping that has transactions from more than one country. For each such channel grouping, find the country with the highest total number of transactions and report both the country name and the sum of transactions for that channel grouping.
sql:
WITH deduped AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId, channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country, totals_transactions
  FROM `data-to-insights.ecommerce.rev_transactions`
),
country_txn AS (
  SELECT channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country, SUM(totals_transactions) as total_transactions
  FROM deduped
  GROUP BY channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country
),
channel_country_count AS (
  SELECT channelGrouping, COUNT(DISTINCT geoNetwork_country) as num_countries
  FROM country_txn
  GROUP BY channelGrouping
  HAVING num_countries > 1
)
SELECT cc.channelGrouping, cc.geoNetwork_country, cc.total_transactions
FROM country_txn cc
INNER JOIN channel_country_count ccc ON cc.channelGrouping = ccc.channelGrouping
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.channelGrouping ORDER BY cc.total_transactions DESC) = 1
ORDER BY cc.channelGrouping
